statusText: Mapped policy state: EA_ON. NQ is closed for the weekend; Saudi pipeline and Red Sea shipping disruption keep reopening-gap uncertainty high, but no live NQ path can confirm persistent mean-reversion failure.
recommendation: Mapped policy state: EA_ON; Tail remains below WATCH because the current shock is closed-market reopening risk rather than observed one-way NQ structure.
headline: Weekend energy escalation keeps Stress extreme while closed NQ leaves Tail low
body: Reuters reports Saudi Arabia temporarily shut its East-West pipeline after attacks while Houthis seized Perim at Bab el-Mandeb. Friday U.S. equities closed higher as VIX eased, but oil and yields remain elevated. With NQ closed, current path persistence cannot be observed.

Stress stayed extreme and rose again on weekend energy escalation.
